patterns.rhetorical_purpose: n/a -- documenting a structural feature to avoid copying directly, not a quality flaw in the source
move_sequence: numbered finding list (1-7) with no explicit transition between findings
patterns.signature: seven independently-numbered findings, each self-contained, with no stated logical relation between finding N and finding N+1
patterns.reader_effect: efficient for a specialist skimming for a specific comparison, but for an adjacent-field reader building a first mental model, the lack of connective tissue can read as a list of facts rather than one argument
patterns.repair_principle: for this paper's mode-B audience, group the findings under the paragraph model (point first, evidence, explicit link back/forward) and order them by the reader's next question rather than by an arbitrary numbering, per information_design.md §1 and §4
